blurb: A Roman town frozen on one day in AD 79.

facts.t: When Vesuvius erupted in AD 79, ash and hot gas buried Pompeii and Herculaneum. Pliny the Younger watched from across the bay and wrote two letters about it; his uncle Pliny the Elder died trying to rescue people.

src.n: Wikipedia: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD

facts.t: From 1863 the archaeologist Giuseppe Fiorelli poured plaster into the hollows left by bodies in the ash, giving the shapes of people at the moment they died.
